construction.proof:
Complete-owner cubical product and common restoration

Let a complete native packing of m copies of a canonical solid P lie in
a cube of side t centered at c0. Subtract c0 from every source center.
For q in {2,3}, put b_z=t*(z-(q-1)/2*(1,1,1)) for every ordered grid word
z in {0,...,q-1}^3. The q^3 boxes b_z+[-t/2,t/2]^3 have disjoint interiors
and fill [-qt/2,qt/2]^3. Copy every complete source owner into each box,
keeping its actual quaternion. This gives q^3*m jointly compatible whole
owners. Within a box, compatibility is the source packing. Between boxes,
one actual coordinate wall separates their complete containing boxes.
No pair is allowed to choose an independent box location or host scale.

For native restoration let rho=10000001/10000000. Apply rho to EVERY
constructed center while retaining the unit solid and quaternion. Because
the origin is interior to every canonical body, each support value is
positive: a separator gap gains (rho-1) times its two support values,
and a host-wall margin gains (rho-1) times the owner's support value.
Thus the entire packing remains strictly disjoint inside side rho*q*t.
The final host side is rounded outward with an additional 1e-7. Each
center is evaluated as an exact rational then rounded once to binary64;
the final native certificate verifies that rounding on every pair/wall.

The complete grid-word/source-owner decoder is retained. A smaller count
is its literal ordered whole-owner prefix; no remaining center or frame
changes. Classical Cartesian products and every donor's original author
